fullDescription: A calm, editorial image carousel built as a complete one-screen gallery landing on a graphite + off-white 'paper' palette with a single platinum accent. A sticky translucent paper nav over a centered hero band (a 'Carousel Design' pill eyebrow, an extrabold tight-tracked 'A gallery that frames the work, not itself.' headline, a muted intro line), then the carousel: a meta row ('Editorial Set 04' / 'Forms in Low Light' + an '03 / 09' counter) above a single commanding 16:9 hero frame on a near-black graphite stage with a soft bottom vignette, quiet glass prev/next caret arrows that stay calm until hover, a bottom-left 'Frame 03 / Ridge at Dusk' caption, a bottom-right glass play/fullscreen cluster and centered dot pagination, synced to a horizontally-scrolling thumbnail strip whose active thumb wears a double-ring highlight (the rest at 55% opacity, brightening on hover, the right edge masked). Below: a hairline-gridded three-up feature row, a full-bleed dark graphite palette section with a four-swatch ramp (#1c1c1e / #2c2c2e / #c7c7cc / #fbfbfa) and an 'Open the editor' CTA, and a paper footer. Inter throughout with tight display tracking.
prompt: ## Resumo A calm, editorial image carousel rendered as a complete one-screen gallery landing on a graphite + off-white 'paper' palette. A sticky translucent paper nav sits over a centered hero band (an uppercase 'Carousel Design' pill eyebrow, an extrabold tight-tracked 'A gallery that frames the work, not itself.' headline, and a muted intro line), then the carousel itself: a meta row ('Editorial Set 04' label + a bold 'Forms in Low Light' title on the left, an 'images' icon + '03 / 09' counter on the right) above a single commanding 16:9 hero frame on a near-black graphite stage with a soft bottom vignette, glass prev/next caret arrows that sit quiet until hover, a bottom-left 'Frame 03 / Ridge at Dusk' caption, a bottom-right glass control cluster (play + fullscreen), and a centered dot-pagination row. Beneath the stage a precise horizontally-scrolling thumbnail strip (the active thumb wears a double-ring 'thumb-active' highlight, the rest sit at 55% opacity with a hairline ring and brighten on hover, the right edge fades out via a mask). Below the carousel a three-up feature row in a hairline-gridded card ('Thumb-synced focus', 'Quiet arrows', 'Swipes at 390'), then a full-bleed dark graphite palette section ('Graphite, off-white, a single platinum line.' with a four-swatch ramp #1c1c1e / #2c2c2e / #c7c7cc / #fbfbfa and a paper 'Open the editor' CTA), then a paper footer. Restrained monochrome aesthetic: graphite #1c1c1e on paper #fbfbfa with a single platinum #c7c7cc accent line, Inter throughout with tight display tracking. ## Estilo Visual Calm editorial image-carousel / gallery landing on an off-white 'paper' + graphite monochrome palette with a single platinum accent. Tailwind CDN with a custom theme.extend: colors.graphite { 50 #f7f7f8, 100 #ececee, 200 #d8d8dc, 300 #b7b7bd, 400 #8e8e93, 500 #636366, 600 #48484a, 700 #3a3a3c, 800 #2c2c2e, 900 #1c1c1e }, platinum #c7c7cc, paper #fbfbfa; fontFamily.sans ['Inter','system-ui','sans-serif']; letterSpacing.tightest -0.045em. Load Inter (weights 300;400;500;600;700;800) from Google Fonts and Iconify (https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js). CSS keys: html scroll-behavior smooth; body background #fbfbfa, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased, text graphite-900; .tracking-display letter-spacing -0.045em; ::selection background #1c1c1e color #fbfbfa. The active thumbnail uses .thumb-active { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fbfbfa, 0 0 0 4px #1c1c1e } plus a .thumb-active::after inset hairline { content '', position absolute, inset 0, border-radius 0.5rem, box-shadow inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(199,199,204,0.55) }. The hero frame gets .hero-shadow { box-shadow 0 30px 60px -25px rgba(28,28,30,0.45), 0 12px 24px -16px rgba(28,28,30,0.30) } and a soft bottom vignette via .img-grain { position relative } + .img-grain::after { content '', absolute inset-0, pointer-events none, background linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(28,28,30,0) 55%, rgba(28,28,30,0.42) 100%) }. Glass controls use .glass { background rgba(28,28,30,0.72); backdrop-filter blur(14px) saturate(150%) } over a white/20 ring. The palette paper chip uses .swatch { background repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0 6px, rgba(255,255,255,0) 6px 12px) }. The thumbnail strip right edge fades via .fade-edge-r { mask-image linear-gradient(90deg, #000 88%, transparent 100%) } and hides its scrollbar (scrollbar-width none). Graphite is the type/structure value, paper #fbfbfa is the ground and the type-on-dark color, platinum #c7c7cc is the single accent (the inset thumb hairline + the dark CTA hover). Images via Unsplash photos. Icons via Iconify Phosphor 'ph:*' set. Warm human copy, zero em-dashes ('A gallery that frames the work, not itself.', 'one commanding hero frame, a precise thumbnail strip, arrows that stay out of the way until you need them.', 'Three values do the work.'). ## Layout e Estrutura ### Sticky translucent nav A sticky top-0 z-50 header with a border-b border-graphite-200/70 over a bg-paper/80 backdrop-blur-xl fill. Inner nav = mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6, 64px tall (h-16), flex items-center justify-between. LEFT: a brand lockup = a 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded-lg bg-graphite-900 text-paper tile holding a 17px ph:square-half-bold icon, beside a 15px font-semibold tracking-display 'Frame' + a graphite-400 'Studio' wordmark. CENTER (hidden below md, md:flex, gap-9): four 13.5px font-medium graphite-600 nav links 'Gallery' / 'Layouts' / 'Pricing' / 'Docs' (hover graphite-900). RIGHT: a hidden-below-sm 13.5px graphite-600 'Sign in' link + a rounded-full bg-graphite-900 px-4 py-2 13px font-semibold text-paper 'Start free' button (hover bg-graphite-700). ### Hero / intro band A relative overflow-hidden border-b border-graphite-200/70 bg-paper section with two pointer-events-none soft blurred decorative blobs (an -right-32 -top-28 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-graphite-100 blur-3xl, and an -left-24 top-24 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-platinum/30 blur-3xl). Inner = relative mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 pb-12 pt-16 (md:pt-20), a centered mx-auto max-w-3xl text-center: (1) an inline-flex rounded-full border border-graphite-200 bg-white/60 px-3.5 py-1.5, 11.5px font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] graphite-500 pill eyebrow with a 6px graphite-900 dot + the text 'Carousel Design'; (2) an mt-6 Inter font-extrabold leading-[1.03] tracking-display graphite-900 headline at text-[42px] (md:text-[64px]) reading 'A gallery that frames' + a sm-only line break + 'the work, not itself.'; (3) an mx-auto mt-5 max-w-xl 15px (md:16.5px) leading-relaxed graphite-500 intro paragraph ('A calm, graphite image carousel: one commanding hero frame, a precise thumbnail strip, arrows that stay out of the way until you need them.'). ### Carousel meta row Inside a bg-paper #gallery section (mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 py-12 md:py-16), a mb-5 flex items-end justify-between row: LEFT a label block = an 11.5px font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] graphite-400 'Editorial Set 04' eyebrow over an mt-1 22px (md:26px) font-bold tracking-display graphite-900 'Forms in Low Light' title; RIGHT a hidden-below-sm flex items-center gap-2, 12.5px font-medium graphite-500 counter = a 16px ph:images-square icon + a '03 / 09' span (the '03' in graphite-900, the rest graphite-500). ### Hero stage (the active frame) A figure.img-grain.hero-shadow group = a relative aspect-[16/9] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-graphite-900 ring-1 ring-graphite-900/5 stage. Inside: (1) a full-bleed object-cover (an Unsplash landscape) that scales to 1.015 on group-hover over a 700ms ease-out transition; (2) the .img-grain::after bottom vignette. Overlaid controls (all z-10): a prev and a next glass caret button = absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2, left-4 (md:left-6) / right-4 (md:right-6), an h-11 w-11 rounded-full .glass text-paper ring-1 ring-white/20 (hover bg-graphite-900/90) holding an 18px ph:caret-left-bold / ph:caret-right-bold icon. A bottom-left figcaption (absolute bottom-5 left-5, md:bottom-6 md:left-7): an 11px font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-platinum 'Frame 03' over an mt-1 18px (md:22px) font-semibold tracking-display text-paper 'Ridge at Dusk'. A bottom-right control cluster (absolute bottom-5 right-5, md:bottom-6 md:right-6, flex items-center gap-2): two h-9 w-9 rounded-full .glass text-paper ring-1 ring-white/20 buttons (a 13px ph:play-fill 'autoplay' + a 14px ph:corners-out 'fullscreen'). A centered dot pagination (absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2, hidden below md, md:flex items-center gap-2): one active h-1.5 w-5 rounded-full bg-paper pill + five h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-paper/45 dots. ### Thumbnail strip An mt-4 (md:mt-5) wrapper holding a .fade-edge-r -mx-1 flex gap-2.5 (md:gap-3) overflow-x-auto px-1 pb-1 row with scrollbar-width none. Nine thumbnail

style.description: A calm, editorial, almost-monochrome aesthetic where the image is the only color and the chrome stays out of the way. The whole page sits on an off-white 'paper' #fbfbfa ground with a graphite ramp (50 #f7f7f8 through 900 #1c1c1e) for type, borders and the dark stage, a single platinum #c7c7cc reserved as the one accent value, and pure-white pill/card surfaces. Typography is Inter at every weight (300..800) with a tight display tracking (-0.045em via .tracking-display / letterSpacing.tightest) on headlines, the wordmark and section titles, and a muted graphite-500 for body. The carousel hero is a near-black graphite-900 stage with a soft bottom-up vignette gradient (the .img-grain::after overlay) so captions stay legible, a large soft drop shadow (.hero-shadow), and a 1px graphite ring. Controls are 'glass': rgba(28,28,30,0.72) with backdrop-blur(14px) saturate(150%) and a white/20 ring, sitting quiet until hover then snapping to near-solid graphite. The active thumbnail wears a double box-shadow ring (a 2px paper gap then a 4px graphite ring via .thumb-active) plus an inset platinum hairline; inactive thumbs sit at 55% opacity behind a graphite-200 ring and brighten to full on hover. Soft decorative blurred blobs (graphite-100 and platinum/30) bleed off the hero band corners, a diagonal repeating-linear-gradient 'swatch' texture marks the paper chip in the palette ramp, and a linear-gradient mask fades the right edge of the thumbnail strip. Smooth scroll, antialiased text, a graphite ::selection. Calm, precise, gallery-like; warm human copy with zero em-dashes.

The reusable prompt-library value is the IMAGE CAROUSEL pattern: one commanding 16:9 hero frame on a dark stage with quiet glass arrows + an in-frame caption + dot pagination, synced to a horizontally-scrolling thumbnail strip whose active thumb shares a double-ring highlight, in a restrained graphite + off-white skin, wrapped into a complete one-screen gallery landing (a sticky translucent nav, a centered hero band, a three-up feature row, a dark palette section and a footer). Original prompt-library product for the placeholder brand 'FrameStudio'. Responsive: the hero keeps its 16:9 frame, the dot pagination + counter hide below md/sm, the thumbnail strip scrolls horizontally with a right-edge mask, the feature row + palette section collapse to one column, the headline clamps 42px -> 64px, no overflow at 390px.
